title: NETWORK REPORTS CANDIDATE SIGNAL
body: VOLUNTEERS OF THE OBSERVER NETWORK TODAY REPORTED THE FIRST DETECTION OF A CANDIDATE NARROWBAND SIGNAL, RECEIVED ON 14 MARCH 2001.
"THIS IS WHAT 40,000 SPARE COMPUTERS CAN DO," SAID DIRECTOR DR. MARIT OYELARAN. "WE ARE PROUD TO SAY NOBODY HAS EVER SEEN THIS BEFORE."
